content: IEEE-754 canonicalization pitfalls for hashing raw bytes: NaN payloads are not unique bit patterns any nonzero mantissa with all-1s exponent and NaN not equal NaN breaks naive equality; -0.0 and +0.0 are numerically equal but bit-distinct; denormals/subnormals are frequently flushed-to-zero by GPU hardware but not always by CPU paths, a divergence source; truncating mantissa bits during quantization can accidentally flip a NaN encoding into Infinity if it zeroes the whole mantissa. No single canonical-serialization library found for this exact hash use case; pattern must be assembled from IEEE-754 primitives.
